snippet.title: KERO CORP -- Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re proud to announce that Linari Games and Ao Norte have partnered with Monster Theater for the publication of KERO CORP in spring 2027. 

Monster Theater has teamed up with Linari Games and Ao Norte to bring the hybrid incremental typing game KERO CORP to Steam early next year. Monster Theater is contributing quality assurance, balancing, marketing support, creative liaison, and additional writing to the project beginning in Q4 2026.  

Title: KERO CORP
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4222130/KERO_CORP/ 

Developers: Linari Games, Ao Norte
Publisher: Monster Theater

Genre: Typing-Incremental
Platform: PC (Steam)

Publisher Links below:

Monster Theater: https://monstertheater.carrd.co/
Contact Twitter: https://x.com/monstertheaterx
Email: contact@monstertheater.games
